notes.title: 08.01.2016 Massive hotfix crash bug fix
notes.notes:
First of all, thank you for your patience and being awesome by reporting bugs that prevented playing the game. I did a very careful deep scan of all the dialogue that might have caused these problems and fixed them all as I encountered them. I also fixed several smaller bugs including some related to secrets and their functionality. Here's the full patch list of things fixed

Crash cases in some of the dialogue has been fixed, including: 

* Talking with E.M.O. after removing painting
* Talking with E.M.O first time. 
* Several cases of inspecting items
* Starting projector and seeing slideshow
* Looking at "staff"
* Talking with Gusta
* Defeating SF IV boss
* End credits

Other fixes:
* Typo: "did you saw that" fixed.
* Safe can no longer be used once it's open, preventing double money
* Tank lowering and rising up no longer bugs out the sound into infinite loop
* When battling Communistic Quest version of a boss fight the boss is now less randomly defeated. Every hit toward player character now increases the chances of boss getting hit himself.
*You can now exit the secrets menu after finding game's last secret, even if the last secret was the first you found

*Small enhacements into overall quality all over

Have fun trying to explore and survive the Russian bunker!

notes.notes:
Rejoice and party hard, Bunker - The Underground Game has just added the trading cards to it's collection, add them to yours! 

Fifteen cards don't only feature art found within the game but when zoomed in/opened a nifty trivia about game's development. Earn the various emotes and backgrounds to complete your crazy Bunker set and let your friends see how wacky Steam just can be.

notes.title: Patch 10.04.15
notes.notes:
New website [url=www.bunkerthegame.com]www.bunkerthegame.com[/url], check it out
[list]
[*]Huge font update, all fonts now have outlines making them easier to read. 
[*]Font used with artificial sounds is now correct colour.
[*]Otto now comments every time you try using or doing something that doesn’t work
[*]Various small and severe bug fixes (including few bugs )
[*]Adjustments to cutscenes pacing
[*]Fixed typo at start of the Swords & Fireballs 7
[*]Other typo fixes
[*]When lowering nitrogen tank crank sound shouldn't loop anymore
[*]Rope minigame and animations are now more lively and enchanted with sounds
[*]Poison room's walls no more allow walking on them if you do things in certain sequence
[*]Several other pathfinding bugs fixed
[*]You shouldn't get stuck to ladders in sewer anymore
[*]Hammer's mysterious disappearance bug fixed
[*]Replaced rest of the corrupted graphics files
[*]Fixed some sound related bugs
[*]Combining ice with "vodka" gives now sound
[*]Picking up gold and paper money from safe plays a sound now
[*]Taking hoses when using crank plays a sound now
[*]Using tank wheel plays a sound now
[*]Neutralizing poison room's barrel now playbacks a sound effect
[*]Using wires plays a sound now
[*]Using pirated AK-47's play a sound now
[*]Solving the dog room gives a reward tune
[*]Operating with monitor in the final boss plays a sound. 
[/list]

notes.title: Some launch day patch fixes:
notes.notes:
Preparing for the launch, I've worked tirelessly to include some critical improvements to the game:

Dropping water doesn't follow you entirety of game
Neither does the dog's snoring
Final boss battle has similar sound fix
Camera now follows the action in both credits and robot chase scene
[spoiler]Parody game boss battle no longer crashes game[/spoiler]
Several adjustments to sound levels and additional implemented sounds for better audio experience.
Fine polish to scene transitions
You can't get stuck forever with security guard anymore 
Hoax news font has a better color, more distinguish color
